To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimization of a compiler from PDDL (Planning Domain Definition Language) to Picat (an efficient constraint logic programming language) can improve the performance of Picat’s tabling technique.
(i) a PDDL model can be compiled into Picat code, and (ii) the resulting code can be optimized to better use Picat’s Tabing technique.

1) the compiler is able to produce a Picat code which is more efficient than a code written by hand; 2) the compiler is also able to produce a code that is more efficient than the code produced by a previous compiler; 3) a new representation of the states, based on a new data structure, allows to obtain a code that is even more efficient.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a compiler optimization technique which is based on a different representation of states.
the optimization of a compiler from PDDL models to Picat.
the automatic generation of a more efficient code for a PDDL model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, when the optimization is applied to the compiler’s output, the execution times are improved up to 50%.
the new method is able to improve the performance of Picat in the PDDL domain by up to 30%.
the new representation allows to obtain a significant reduction in the running time.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a compiler from PDDL models to Picat programs and that this compiler can be optimized by a method which is also automatic and that we have shown that the resulting programs can be competitive with the state-of-the-art in international competitions.
, by using this method, the performance of the PDDL to Pical compiler has been significantly improved.
, in the last international competition, the best PDDL model was written in Picat, using our compiler.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimization of a compiler can be achieved by using different representations of the search space, without changing the language of the target platform.
it is possible to automatically obtain a Picat program that is competitive with the best Picat programs that have been manually developed for the considered problems.
